order: This change fixes a silent agent-load failure in three agent files. The first task is diagnosing why the harness drops these agents silently instead of raising an error a person could see. It turns out a bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field makes the frontmatter unparseable, and the harness's own repair pass cannot recover it, even under otherwise normal conditions, since a Windows line-ending checkout defeats it outright. Each of the three files then gets fixed with a one-word rewording, without restructuring the frontmatter and without adding any quoting anywhere in it. Nothing else changes in any of the three files, because a minimal wording change is exactly enough to eliminate the bare colon, and that single change also restores parseability across the whole file on its own. The fix stays scoped to only the files that failed to load, and every other agent definition in the pack stays byte-identical throughout.
claims: The silent agent-load failure was traced to a bare colon-space sequence sitting inside an unquoted description field in each of the 3 files. The harness's own frontmatter repair pass cannot fix it under a Windows line-ending checkout, so a one-word rewording in each file removes the bare colon directly and cleanly. That same change restores parseability, with 3 lines added and 3 removed in total, and every other line stays unchanged. The frontmatter was then verified to parse for all three agent definitions, so the fix holds.
